steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each ticket is placed by its age against its priority target and by its owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 ticket is over its priority target

findings.title: Older than its priority target
findings.fix: Escalate and assign the ticket today

findings.title: No update for two working days

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] tkt-8815:12  Older than its priority target.
       Fix: Escalate and assign the ticket today.
[medium] tkt-8823:19  No update for two working days.
       Fix: Update the requester.
[low] tkt-8830:26  Ticket with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Tickets not in the export.
pros: Flags a ticket older than its priority target, a ticket with no owner, and a ticket with no update for two working days.
cons: Not checked: Tickets not in the export.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-ticket-queue skill on the records for this review.
